name: Yumbo (Colombia)
description: Green field with a white diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly bearing the motto PAZ Y TRABAJO in yellow, and a yellow sun at the upper hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Yumbo, a municipality in the department of Valle del Cauca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
motto PAZ Y TRABAJO on the band
